tasks.title: Project Setup and Repository
tasks.description: Create the project structure, configure the development environment, and prepare the Git repository.
userStories: As a developer, I want a ready project structure so that development can start consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: The project repository is initialized.
The required folders and starter files are present.
The project runs locally.

tasks.title: Design Database and Data Models
tasks.description: Define the main entities and relationships needed for products, customers, and orders.
userStories: As a developer, I want clear data models so that application data is structured consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Product, customer, and order entities are defined.
Relationships between entities are documented.
Required fields and validation rules are identified.

tasks.title: Build Responsive Homepage
tasks.description: Create the storefront homepage with navigation, featured products, and responsive layout.
userStories: As a visitor, I want to browse a clear homepage so that I can discover products easily.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage contains the main navigation and featured section.
The layout works on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Images have appropriate alternative text.

tasks.title: Create Product Listing and Filters
tasks.description: Display products in a catalog and allow visitors to filter and sort the results.
userStories: As a shopper, I want to browse and filter products so that I can find relevant items.
acceptanceCriteria: Products are displayed with key information.
Category filtering works.
Sorting updates the displayed product order.

tasks.title: Build Product Details Page
tasks.description: Create a product details view with images, description, price, and availability.
userStories: As a shopper, I want to inspect a product so that I can decide whether to buy it.
acceptanceCriteria: The page shows product images, description, and price.
The selected product is identified correctly.
The page is responsive.

tasks.title: Implement Shopping Cart
tasks.description: Allow shoppers to add products, change quantities, remove items, and review the cart total.
userStories: As a shopper, I want to manage my cart so that I can review the items I plan to purchase.
acceptanceCriteria: Products can be added to the cart.
Quantities can be changed and items removed.
The cart total updates when the cart changes.

tasks.title: Create Checkout Form and Validation
tasks.description: Build a checkout form and validate the customer and delivery information before submission.
userStories: As a shopper, I want to enter delivery details so that I can complete my order.
acceptanceCriteria: Required checkout fields are present.
Invalid or missing values show clear validation messages.
A valid form can be submitted in the demo flow.

tasks.title: Add Order Confirmation
tasks.description: Show a confirmation screen after a successful simulated checkout.
userStories: As a shopper, I want confirmation after checkout so that I know my order was received.
acceptanceCriteria: A confirmation message is displayed after valid checkout.
The confirmation includes a generated order reference.
The cart is cleared after successful demo checkout.

tasks.title: Responsive and Functional Testing
tasks.description: Test the main shopping flow, fix issues, and verify responsive behavior across screen sizes.
userStories: As a project stakeholder, I want the main user flow tested so that the demo is reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage, catalog, product page, cart, and checkout are tested.
The main flow works at mobile and desktop widths.
Critical defects found during testing are fixed.
